RELIC_CORE.target: Observer-first temporal continuity and provenance service for AI and software engineering.
RELIC_CORE.authority: Durable evidence with status, provenance, sequence and hashes preserved.
must_preserve: append history instead of silent overwrite

RELIC_OBSERVATORY.target: Record engineering experience across code change, build/test, deployment, runtime report, investigation, correction and verification.
RELIC_OBSERVATORY.authority: Observed engineering evidence; causation requires evidence.
must_preserve: user reports begin with cause UNKNOWN

RELIC_SHARE.target: Public/hackathon demonstration and engineering report of ReLiC continuity without exposing private write authority.
RELIC_SHARE.authority: Representation of bounded ReLiC evidence, not the authoritative store.

SHAELVIEN.target: Persistent world and worldbuilding system whose canon, rules, world state and representations remain distinguishable.
SHAELVIEN.authority: Approved Shaelvien canon plus currently inspected implementation for current software behavior.
must_preserve: Canon -> Rules -> World State -> Representation -> Generated Content

RIST.target: Runtime/interface and authority framework for Shaelvien roleplay and GameMaster experiences across input methods and accessibility needs.
RIST.authority: Current tested implementation and explicit project canon.
must_preserve: no partial-patch drift across duplicate implementations

RUNECORE_WAVECORE.target: Explore symbolic interpretation and waveform/state-computation concepts without presenting unverified models as established implementation or science.
RUNECORE_WAVECORE.authority: Experiment results and explicitly promoted project canon only.

FORsyth_TECH_LEARNING.target: Maintain learning continuity across coursework while helping the learner understand and retain material rather than doing coursework for them.
FORsyth_TECH_LEARNING.authority: Course sources and demonstrated understanding; technology-delta notes remain separate.
